Helpful before you visit

The little details.

A few answers to help you move from inspiration to a practical plan. Anything product-specific can be confirmed by the showroom.

Please note: this website prototype does not process payments or confirm stock, delivery, installation, or returns. Those details should be agreed directly with Kani Ceramics before an order is placed.
Can I check the price and availability online?

Prices and stock are currently listed as “on request”. Add items to your selection and request a quote so the showroom can confirm current availability and pricing.

Are the room images an exact preview?

No. The visualiser is a design-inspiration preview. Screen settings, lighting, tile batch, scale, and placement can change the real-world appearance. Ask to view a physical sample before deciding.

How do I estimate how many tiles I need?

Measure the room dimensions and note doors, windows, niches, and any unusual angles. A tile professional should confirm the area, layout, cuts, and suitable allowance for wastage before you order.

Do you provide delivery or installation?

Please contact the showroom to confirm available delivery areas, charges, lead times, and whether installation services or installer referrals are offered.

What about returns, damaged items, or order changes?

Ask for the current written policy before payment, including how to report transit damage, the inspection window, return eligibility, and whether special-order products can be changed.

How do I enquire about a tile?

Select a tile or product above, or tell us what you are exploring in the enquiry form. Include your preferred contact details and room type. The form prepares a message; this demo does not send it automatically.
